_comment: Scoped service tokens for the orchestration API. Copy to the path named by
chmod 0600. Only the SHA-256 DIGEST of each token is stored, never the token itself:
generate one with `openssl rand -hex 32`, hand that value to the orchestrator, and record
Rotation needs no outage. Add the incoming token alongside the outgoing one, move the
orchestrator across, then set `disabled: true` on the old entry rather than deleting it, so
the audit trail survives the rotation. The file is re-read when it changes on disk.
SCOPES ARE SEPARABLE ON PURPOSE. Note that the orchestrator entry below does NOT carry
`approve`: one credential that can request work, approve it, and publish it is not a gate.
Hold `approve` on a separate credential used by whatever records human decisions. Even with
both scopes on one token, the default configuration refuses an approval from the credential

tokens._comment: Held by whatever records human decisions — never by the orchestrator itself.
